crafted with precision and attention to
detail.
The design was carefully tailored to
match the client’s vision, blending
modern aesthetics with functional space
solutions. The client expressed immense

project was completed to the highest
standards of craftsmanship, ensuring
both longevity and aesthetic appeal.

Empire Square
Oryx Carpentry designed a stunning TV wall and partition, both
crafted using high-quality MDF wood. The modern design of the TV
wall incorporates sleek, clean lines that create a contemporary and
functional focal point for the room. The partition seamlessly divides
the space while maintaining an open, airy feel, ensuring the room
remains inviting and stylish.

features for various sectors. Notable works include custom office furniture and
shelving for Hiwa Group, bespoke cabinetry and wood paneling for the Villa in New
Azadi, and a modern dressing room with high-quality MDF wood for a villa in

in Empire Diamond, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere, as well as custom

pages.text:
Other Works
Oryx Carpentry has successfully completed a wide range of carpentry projects,
showcasing our expertise in designing and crafting high-quality, functional wooden
features for various sectors. Notable works include custom office furniture and
shelving for Hiwa Group, bespoke cabinetry and wood paneling for the Villa in New
Azadi, and a modern dressing room with high-quality MDF wood for a villa in
Dream City. We also designed and installed wooden elements for La Corsica Cafe
in Empire Diamond, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere, as well as custom
tables, chairs, and accents for Nay Restaurant in Park View. Additionally, we built
over 20 custom booths for an international fair, focusing on both style and
functionality.
